_comment: Filter to apply when configuring node 'listEntraGroups1' in CeqlWhereTest/CeqlWhereTest/CeqlWhereTest.flow
_configure_command: uip maestro flow node configure CeqlWhereTest.flow listEntraGroups1 --detail "$(cat listEntraGroups1.detail.json)" --output json
notes: The 'where' parameter on list-groups uses component=FilterBuilder; pass --detail.filter (structured tree), never --detail.queryParameters.where (raw CEQL string).
The CLI compiles the tree into both the runtime queryParameters.where CEQL string AND the design-time savedFilterTrees.where blob required by Studio Web.
Replace <CONNECTION_UUID> and <FOLDER_KEY> with values from: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory --all-folders --output json
